name: marker-relog
description: Volume markers across worlds and a relog (client marker cache follows its level; the join resync refills it). World A: build and connect a box, look. Leave, join world B (a copy of A with the same dimension key and the same coordinates, markers placed but NOT connected): no box may be drawn. Leave, rejoin A: the box must be back. Both worlds are left marker-free, because a world that still holds the markers sends them (or their removal) to the client and would hide a stale connection; delete saves/bc-smoke-b if either was left dirty. Run it a second time after the very first run on a node, which only creates the world the second save is copied from.

steps.label: A: right-click a marker to connect the box

steps.name: A-connected
steps.look: a red laser box spans the four markers

steps.label: select the second world in the list (A was just played, so it is first)
play it (the click can report a timeout on some nodes while the world loads; inWorld is the real check)
B: same rig, markers NOT connected (no clearing first: removing a marker tells the client to forget it, which would hide a stale connection)

steps.name: B-no-stale-box
steps.look: four markers and NO red box: world A's connection must not be drawn in world B

steps.label: B: take the rig down again, so both saves are marker-free for the next run
select the second world in the list (B was just played, so it is first)
play it (the click can report a timeout on some nodes while the world loads; inWorld is the real check)

steps.name: A-after-relog
steps.look: the same red box as A-connected: the join resync brought the connection back

steps.label: A: take the rig down again (B is copied from A, and must start without markers)
